exercise1.prompt: A chart without units is a decoration, and a cut axis is an argument.

hiddenCases.name: the gap is measured, not assumed
the leader is whichever team is actually highest
the means come from a group-by
hiddenCases.describe: a grouped mean behind the sentence

exercise1.hint: Group to a mean per team, round to one place, then use idxmax and idxmin for the names. The gap is the difference between the two means.

questions.prompt: Why does a bar chart's value axis normally start at zero?
choices: The length of the bar is the quantity, so cutting the axis distorts the comparison
questions.explain: A bar encodes its value as length. Start at 98 and a one-point difference fills the chart, which is a claim the data did not make.

questions.prompt: What belongs on a chart before anyone else sees it?
choices: A title saying what it shows
questions.explain: The first three let a reader act on it. The code belongs with the work, not on the picture.

questions.prompt: When is a non-zero axis defensible?
choices: On a line chart of a quantity that moves in a narrow band, where the change is the subject
questions.explain: A line encodes change as slope rather than length, so a tight band can be legitimate -- provided the axis is labelled and the reader can see it.
